retrieval_top3.text: Course Code: CSE 207 Course Title: Algorithm Credits: 3.00 Prerequisite: CSE 103, CSE 205 Introduction: The role of algorithms in computing. Complexity analysis: Growth of function, asymptotic notations, orders, designing worst case and average-case. Recurrence relations : Substitution method, iteration method, master method. Divide and Conquer: Basic idea, control structure properties of D & C, applications of D & C. Dynamic Programming : Elements of Dynamic Programming, Comparison with D & C. Application of Dynamic programming in: Optimal binary search tree, 0/1 Knapsack problem. Greedy Method : Elements of greedy method, basic control structure, Application of Greedy method in: Minimum cost span ning tree, Huffman code, Job sequencing with deadline. Backtracking: Basic idea behind backtracking, control structure. Application of backtracking in: graph coloring problem, n -queens problems. Branch and Bound : Basic idea and control structure of Branch and Bound. FIFO branch and Bound, LC Branch and Bound, the l5 -puzzle problem. Graph related algorithms: Breadth First search, Depth First search, Topological sort, Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm, The Bellman -Ford algorithm for single source shortest p ath, The Floyd -War shall algorithm for all pair shortest path, Johnson's algorithm for sparse graph, Flow networks, the Ford -Fulkerson
